title: Sunrise Hearts
description: A new punishment system for Minecraft. Reworks the effect dying has. KeepInventory enabled. Limited multi-player use.
body:
- 1 Death reduces the player to 8 hearts.
- 2 Deaths reduces the player to 6 hearts.
- 4 Deaths removes Keep Inventory gamerule.
Deaths not tracked beyond 4.
On Sunrise, remove 1 death from each player.

Alternate config available in versions, do take a look.

You cannot set gamerule KeepInventory false manually with this datapack.

For multi-player: if one player is on 4 deaths, gamerule KeepInventory false applies to whole server. I've also not tested it :)

No config - barebones datapack.
